title: Prioritize historical Paper and Live Net accounting for ETH Up 50 bps Instant
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: А можно в виде исключения пересчитать стратегию ETH Up or Down 5m Up 50 bps Instant ? Paper и Live ставки

scope.goal: Give the exact ETH Up or Down 5m Up 50 bps Instant strategy a closed one-time priority in the existing historical Gross/Net parity service so its pre-cutoff Paper and Live accounting completes before the service returns automatically to the ordinary current-Gross queue.
inScope: Exact strategy b7c50005-0000-4000-8079-000000000150 / eth_up_down_5m_up_bps_50_instant / ETH Up or Down 5m Up 50 bps Instant only.

A closed priority exception in the existing HistoricalGrossNetParity strategy-selection path: when this strategy is unfinished, select it ahead of the ordinary Gross ranking while preserving its actual observed Gross and rank in logs and audit evidence.
All existing canonical historical Paper and Live contribution source kinds for the exact strategy whose proved originating time is strictly earlier than 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC.
Existing exact, authoritative and local Polymarket Fee precedence followed by the already approved direct Fixed0p0333 fallback when an exact Fee cannot be determined.

Existing bounded pages, exact-to-fallback phases, restart reconstruction, immutable accounting audit, reconciliation, Live initial-balance ordering, CAS/idempotency and late VenueReported revision behavior.
After the exact strategy is terminally complete, automatic continuation of the unchanged ordinary greatest-current-Gross unfinished-strategy ordering.
outOfScope: Any priority exception for another strategy or any general user-configurable priority framework.

Any Paper or Live contribution originating at or after 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC; the verified 130 post-cutoff settled Paper runs and 130 post-cutoff settled Live orders remain on ordinary current accounting and are not historical candidates.

Changing Gross PnL, Gross ROI, stake or cost basis, Fee formula, the exact/local precedence, the Fixed0p0333 formula, candidate membership, source order, page size, timeouts, transaction boundaries, Live balance rules or late VenueReported revisions.
Changing strategy signals, risk, Paper execution, Live order placement, fills, settlements, strategy enablement, live_stakes, service mode or trading configuration.
Production database mutation, service deployment, restart or configuration mutation during this local implementation task.
scope.periodOrFilter: Only canonical Paper and Live contributions for exact strategy UUID b7c50005-0000-4000-8079-000000000150 with proved originating time strictly before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC.
scope.firstVerification: Run a bounded UTC READ ONLY Production preview of the exact strategy identity, Gross rank, pre/post-cutoff Paper and Live counts, Fee/Net coverage and existing parity audit before implementation.

requirements.text: Select the exact ETH Up or Down 5m Up 50 bps Instant strategy as a closed priority exception whenever it has unfinished historical parity work.
requirements.sourceQuote: в виде исключения пересчитать стратегию ETH Up or Down 5m Up 50 bps Instant
acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh service process, if exact strategy UUID b7c50005-0000-4000-8079-000000000150 has at least one unfinished historical candidate, the parity worker selects it before any ordinary current-Gross candidate even though its verified current Gross rank is 175.
The selected strategy remains active through every bounded exact and fallback page, including both Paper and Live source kinds, before another strategy can be selected.
The exception does not falsify financial evidence: candidate and audit records retain the strategy's actual Dashboard Gross value and actual ordinary Gross rank rather than assigning it rank 1.

Once the exact strategy has no unfinished historical candidate, the worker resumes the unchanged greatest-current-Gross ordering; a restart safely reconstructs completion from canonical rows and immutable audit instead of repeating financial writes.
No other strategy can inherit or configure this exception.

verification.expected: Focused tests prove exact-ID priority ahead of a higher-Gross strategy, actual rank/Gross preservation, full exact-to-fallback retention, automatic return to Gross ordering and restart-safe completed-target skipping.

requirements.text: Complete both Paper and Live historical Net accounting for the exact strategy under the existing pre-cutoff financial rules.
acceptanceCriteria: The unchanged cutoff is strict UTC originating time before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z.

The verified preview population is recognized: 408 old settled Paper runs, of which 2 already have exact Net and 406 remain; and 405 old settled Live orders, of which 2 already have exact Net and 403 remain.
Already formula-complete Paper and Live rows are preserved; VenueReported, authoritative repair and approved local exact calculation retain precedence.
When exact Fee cannot be determined for a positive proved basis, persist the existing Fixed0p0333 result Fee = ROUND_AWAY_8(basis * 0.0333) and Net = Gross - Fee; no donor selection is restored.
Existing chronological Live initial-balance application, clamping, durable ownership, idempotency and strictly newer valid VenueReported revision behavior remain unchanged.
The verified 130 post-cutoff settled Paper runs and 130 post-cutoff settled Live orders, all already Net-complete, are not selected or rewritten.

verification.expected: Tests prove unchanged cutoff, Paper and Live inclusion, completed-row preservation, exact-before-Fixed0p0333 behavior, Live balance ordering and late VenueReported revision behavior.

requirements.text: Keep the exception bounded, auditable and isolated from trading and ordinary post-cutoff accounting.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing batch size 50, cycle cadence, command/lock/lookup timeouts, short per-target transactions, compare-and-set guards, durable progress and foreground-work yielding are unchanged.

At the verified starting population, no more than 809 currently Net-missing historical Paper/Live contributions are financially eligible; processing remains incremental and restartable rather than one large transaction.
Logs identify the closed priority selection separately from ordinary greatest-current-Gross selection and continue to report candidates, applied, fallback-eligible, deferred and Live-balance counts.
No source, schema, strategy, order-placement, execution, risk or ordinary post-cutoff accounting behavior changes beyond the exact selection priority.
Focused tests, affected build, requirement validation, diff checks and independent semantic review pass before completion.
